title: AssetForge: Asset-Augmented Task Synthesis for Business Automation Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training business automation agents requires executable tasks that connect a natural-language request to an application state and a verifiable end state. Traditional Rubrics requires Authors to recreate application interfaces, initial records, policy evidence, and outcome checks for each task, entangling business logic with repeated infrastructure work. We introduce AssetForge, an asset-augmented task-construction pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific Rubrics. The assets provide application interfaces, world-state components, policy/evidence carriers, and native assertion definitions; the Rubric directs their instantiation for a particular business task. Executable checks and an additional model-based review validate each candidate, return targeted feedback, and support bounded repair before acceptance. On AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600, fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on 6,000 AssetForge examples yi

translated_title: AssetForge：面向业务自动化智能体的资产增强型任务合成方法
translated_abstract: 训练业务自动化智能体需要可执行的任务，这些任务将自然语言请求与应用状态和可验证的最终状态相连接。传统的评估准则要求作者为每个任务重新创建应用界面、初始记录、政策证据和结果检查，使业务逻辑与重复的基础设施工作纠缠在一起。我们提出了AssetForge，这是一个资产增强的任务构建流水线，它将可复用的构建资产库与任务特定的评估准则配对使用。资产提供应用界面、世界状态组件、政策/证据载体和原生断言定义；评估准则则指导这些资产针对特定业务任务的实例化。可执行的检查和额外的基于模型的审查用于验证每个候选任务，返回有针对性的反馈，并在接受前支持有界修复。在AutomationBench v1.0.6 public-600上，使用6,000个AssetForge示例对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行微调（摘要在此处截断，后续结果内容缺失）。
tldr: 提出AssetForge流水线，通过将可复用的构建资产库与任务特定评估准则相结合，自动生成经过可执行检查与模型审查验证的业务自动化智能体训练任务，从而将业务逻辑与重复的基础设施构建工作解耦。
en_tdlr: AssetForge is an asset-augmented task-synthesis pipeline that pairs a reusable construction-asset library with task-specific rubrics to automatically generate verified, executable training tasks for business automation agents, decoupling business logic from repetitive infrastructure work.
